slides.texte_overlay:
Why every man should
have a mentor
A mentor shows you shortcuts. They've already made the mistakes you're about to make. One honest conversation can save you years.
A mentor sees what you can't. Your blind spots, your strengths, your habits. An outside view helps you grow faster.
A mentor opens doors. Introductions, recommendations, opportunities. People trust the people their mentors trust.
Finding one is simpler than you think. Ask someone you admire for a coffee and come with good questions. Most people are happy to help.
Learn from great minds every day too. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and history is full of mentors.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. History is full of mentors.

slides.texte_overlay: Make it easy for them. Be on time, be prepared, follow their advice and tell them what happened. Mentors love seeing progress.
Become a mentor later. Help someone younger. Passing on what you learned is one of the most meaningful things a man can do.
